```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(tsibble)
library(forecast)
```
Importing Libraries

```{r}
df <- read_csv("C:/Users/Dhruv/Downloads/electricity_consumption.csv")

df_total <- df %>%
  filter(sector == "total") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  select(date, consumption) %>%
  as_tsibble(index = date)

ts_data <- ts(df_total$consumption, start = c(2018, 1), frequency = 12)

# 1. Time Series Plot
autoplot(df_total, consumption) +
  ggtitle("Time Series Plot of Electricity Consumption") +
  ylab("Consumption (MWh)") +
  xlab("Date")

# 2. Seasonal Plot (ggseason-style)
ggseasonplot(ts_data, year.labels = TRUE, year.labels.left = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("Seasonal Plot: Electricity Consumption by Month") +
  ylab("Consumption (MWh)") +
  xlab("Month")

# 3. Monthly Faceted Plot
df_total %>%
  mutate(Month = lubridate::month(date, label = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = lubridate::year(date), y = consumption)) +
  geom_line(group = 1, color = "steelblue") +
  facet_wrap(~ Month, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Electricity Consumption by Month (Faceted)",
       x = "Year", y = "Consumption (MWh)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
